data.body:
**[P2] Store a weak invocation claim in the ContextVar**

The ContextVar strongly retains the plugin in every copied thread/task context. `unbind_invocation` can clear only its current context, so a long-lived context claimed by an invocation retains the discarded plugin, its spans, and context tokens indefinitely; it also prevents the `WeakSet` from cleaning up an invocation whose end hook never ran. Store a `weakref.ref` in the ContextVar and dereference it during resolution/unbinding, with a test that keeps a claimed context alive while confirming the ended plugin can be collected.
